tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon observations support positive gain and the recalled mechanism predicts reversal only around H≈15–25. A discriminating long-horizon measurement is necessary to identify that behavior before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a four-parameter dual-horizon reversal law from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations are at H≤0.48, so they do not identify the slow timescale or establish behavior near the target H=24.2.
More short-horizon samples would not resolve the key long-horizon ambiguity.
It is unrelated to the candidate endogenous adaptation mechanism and is explicitly not worth acquiring.
